title: Austin Housing: Budget & Program Access
summary:
*   Reviewed the financial status and program activities of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC).
*   Discussed authorizing the remaining 1996-97 budget for the AHFC, with a final decision made the following day.
*   Considered extending or lifting a moratorium on new applications for AHFC housing programs, with a decision reached on January 30.

10-12) were considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors. 1.
